entries.044e38f03cdc12e5: ROHM and its 36 subsidiaries (7 in Japan, 29 overseas) and 3 affiliates (1 in Japan, 2 overseas) make up the group. In Japan, ROHM Hamamatsu Co., Ltd., ROHM Wako Co., Ltd., ROHM Apollo Co., Ltd., ROHM Mechatech Co., Ltd. and Lapis Semiconductor Co., Ltd. handle manufacturing; overseas, subsidiaries in the Philippines, Thailand, China, Malaysia and elsewhere handle manufacturing, and Cycrystal GmbH in Germany produces raw materials for electronic components.
entries.1d6873d7bebcf8ef: It offers analog and logic LSIs, transistors and diodes, power devices, light-emitting diodes, semiconductor lasers, print heads and optical modules, and resistors. The company says that, given the need for energy saving, it aims to expand the use of SiC and other power devices and of insulated gate driver ICs that drive them.
entries.24b833213da7e925: This is a business that manufactures print heads and optical modules.
entries.27cfffeeadf7d11e: This is a business that manufactures [[term:semiconductor|semiconductor]] integrated circuits (LSI) such as analog, logic and memory chips. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥218,390 million (up 7.1% year on year) and segment profit was ¥24,535 million. The company explains that products for body applications and xEVs grew in the automotive market, and that demand for amusement applications in the consumer equipment market and for servers in the computer & storage market recovered.
entries.2bff66e616ab5dea: This is a business that manufactures print heads and optical modules. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥31,589 million (down 3.0% year on year) and segment profit was ¥3,522 million. The company states that print heads increased for office equipment, while optical modules declined for in-vehicle LED modules.
entries.5f35a6bc3e3d6d8f: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and includes the resistor business and others. Resistors are a product that ROHM COMPANY LIMITED has handled since its founding in 1954. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥25,903 million.

entries.7550c5b171097649: As a comprehensive electronic components manufacturer, it mainly manufactures and sells electronic components. Its head office houses divisions organized by product type; each division draws up comprehensive production plans and business strategies for Japan and overseas and conducts production globally, and its reportable segments are based on these product-based divisions. Manufacturing is carried out by ROHM itself and its manufacturing subsidiaries in Japan and overseas, and sales are conducted through overseas sales subsidiaries. All revenue arises from contracts with customers, and no counterparty accounted for 10% or more of revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.8fa0377959e5dc46: The company explains its results by dividing its markets into automotive, industrial equipment, consumer equipment, and computer & storage. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 by customer location was ¥145,144 million in Japan, ¥146.6 billion in China, and ¥189,402 million in other regions. Because no counterparty accounts for 10% or more of revenue, the securities report omits the description of principal customers.

entries.ad043a51519a2281: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,864 million (prior year: operating loss of ¥40,061 million), and ordinary profit was ¥19,222 million (prior year: ordinary loss of ¥29,698 million), but net loss attributable to owners of the parent was ¥158,424 million. The reason was that, as growth prospects for the battery electric vehicle (BEV) market fell below earlier assumptions, the company recorded an impairment loss of ¥193.6 billion as an extraordinary loss, mainly on fixed assets in the SiC business.

entries.b48d39754d1a06b3: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥481,148 million, up 7.3% year on year. The company explains that this was due to revenue growth in the automotive and consumer equipment markets, as well as growth in the industrial equipment market.
